decision: Selected the centroid of Kansas City parcel KIVA PIN 122517 (304 W 10th St / 934 Central St; Lot 3 and the south 70 ft of Lots 4-6, Block 6, Ashburns Addition), the 0.22-acre lot at the northwest corner of 10th Street and Central, as the locator of the proposed 934 Central data-center tower.

selected_properties.layer: Open Data KC dataset 6g4y-sh3m 'Parcels' (City of Kansas City, Missouri), rows last updated 2023-12-30; owner fields not requested

computed.method: WGS84 MultiPolygon from the Socrata the_geom field; centroid computed in EPSG:26915 and returned to WGS84 (EPSG:6512 cross-check gives the same point to 1e-7 degrees); geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid

identity_bridge: Ordinance 260870 (Legistar matter 51069) approves a development plan 'on about 0.23 acres generally located at the northwest corner of 10th Street and Central Avenue in District DC-15' for a 384-foot structure with ground-floor retail and a data center (case CD-CPC-2026-00074); its attachments are titled '934 Central Data Center'.

The city's issued-permits dataset records 934 Central St on main parcel 122517 (zoning clearance CPZ-2026-00055, 7 January 2026; earlier certificate of occupancy CICO-2020-01139 and building permit CPBC-2020-00737 at 934 Central St), and 304 W 10th St on the same parcel.

A box query of the parcel layer around 10th and Central shows parcel 122517 as the corner lot on the west side of Central and the north side of 10th Street: 930 Central St (KIVA 122518, the north 70 ft of Lots 4-6) lies immediately north, and the parcels at 911 Central St and 221 W 10th St lie east of Central.
Parcel 122517 measures 0.224 acres (9,739 sq ft), consistent with the ordinance's 'about 0.23 acres'.
unresolved: The development-plan drawings and staff report are held only on kansascity.legistar1.com, whose robots.txt disallows all agents, so the exact plan boundary (which could include part of the adjoining right of way or the 930 Central lot) was not read; the parcel layer is a December 2023 snapshot.
nearby_records: The imported Lambda Kansas City AI factory and Meta Kansas City records (and their source-record and identity-mapping entries) share a Kansas City locality point 0.84 km to the south-east; both are city-level points for other facilities. No other Atlas, queue, claim or hold coordinate lies within 2 km.
